flora: Brachyphyllum cone (small, globose woody cone with overlapping scales)
Scale-leaves (close-up of short, triangular leaves overlapping like lizard scales)
Brachyphyllum sapling (bushy, dense growth with thick, rope-like branches)

environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'braided' or 'rope-like' appearance of the branches; tactile, scaly textures; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single small globose cone; Top-Right: A close-up of the overlapping scale-leaves; Bottom-Left: A young, bushy sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the rough, patterned bark.
visual_logic.ground: Dry red-brown mudstone with ochre-colored silt patches.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to highlight the geometric precision of the overlapping scales.
